# NorthBridge

> NorthBridge is an AI business automation company for small and medium businesses. It builds and maintains automation workflows, led by an automated payment-chasing system, plus AI client communication and AI fluency training, in English and Spanish, for clients in the United States and Latin America. Based in Quito, Ecuador.

NorthBridge builds the workflows for the client in accounts the client owns (n8n for automation). It is a done-for-you service, not a DIY software tool. Plans start at $99 a month with a 30-day money-back guarantee on the first month and no long contracts. First step is a free first meeting where the payment-chasing workflow is run live on real invoices.

## What NorthBridge does

- Payment chasing automation: checks who has paid, automatically reminds late clients in the owner's tone, notifies the team. Flagship workflow. $99/month pilot, no setup fee, 30-day money-back guarantee.
- Cinderella (data and workflows): cleans data and automates back-office workflows in the client's own n8n account.
- Hermes (client communication): follow-up sequences, instant AI messaging, AI voice agents for calls the owner cannot take, and websites built and kept up to date. Every message template is approved by the client before anything sends.
- Socrates (AI training): hands-on workshops on the team's real daily tasks, AI literacy for schools, talks for events. Virtual anywhere, in person in Quito.
- PerceptFolio (perceptfolio.com): the NorthBridge trading terminal. Every position requires a written thesis, a stop and a deadline. Calibration mode hides the ticker on three years of real daily closes. A single command screen surfaces sell signals, breached limits, stops hit, reviews due and idle cash. Every call is scored against the S&P 500 at 30, 90, 180 and 365 days with confidence intervals, judged on expectancy rather than win rate. It applies rules its operator configures to public data and shows the arithmetic. It is not a broker, executes no trades, holds no client funds, makes no recommendation, and publishes no performance figures.
- Real estate: a fifth practice in preparation, not yet launched.

## Pricing

- Pilot (payment chasing): $99/month, 90 days, money-back guarantee in the first 30 days
- Starter bundle: $299/month
- Growth bundle: $649/month (includes one month of the PerceptFolio terminal free)
- Scale bundle: $699/month (includes one month of the PerceptFolio terminal free)
- Individual practice plans: $99 to $349/month

## How it works

The NorthBridge Cycle: Diagnose (2-3 days), Build (3-7 days), Educate and Train (one session), repeating quarterly. Clients own their n8n accounts and their workflows. NorthBridge takes at most 5 new clients per month.
